Remark
[reparametrization to a geodesic]

Source: petersen:page-0238 ↗ def:pet-ch5-geodesic 1. ch5:5.9.4Show a regular curve can be reparametrized to be a geodesic iff its acceleration is everywhere tangent to the curve.
